description: Return the full plain-text content of a single documentation page, identified by its id (from search_docs) or by its docs.merchinary.com URL. Use this to get complete, step-by-step instructions after a search.

id.description: Page id from a search_docs result, e.g. "bulk-product-editor/field-guides/product-tags".

url.description: Full docs.merchinary.com URL of the page (alternative to id).

name: read_doc
title: Read a Merchinary doc page
